title: The seam keeps the receipt
one_sentence_story: A paper claim travels from one source page through a transparent context capsule, where a cusp twist turns a repeated torus into a six-sided fibre and closes only when the world trace and render receipt agree.
source_boundary: The reference image supplies visual grammar only; the S6 statement remains a paper claim and is not presented as consensus fact.

beats.causal_move: A source artifact emits one luminous evidence stream.
beats.frame: A single warm paper slab stands on the left; one readable label, SOURCE, is the only text. A thin amber filament leaves its lower edge and crosses a dark hexagonal terrain plane.
beats.narration: Start with the source, not the conclusion.

beats.causal_move: The evidence stream enters a transparent Context Capsule and becomes a bounded claim path.
beats.frame: The amber filament passes through a glass rectangular capsule at center. Inside it, a small torus repeats once over a dark base curve; a single clean label, CONTEXT, sits on the capsule face.
beats.narration: Context does not decorate the trace; it bounds what the trace can say.

beats.causal_move: The cusp is marked as the only transition point and twists the torus fibre.
beats.frame: The capsule opens into a dark base curve with three fixed luminous markers: 3, 4, and infinity. The infinity marker brightens; a cyan seam winds around the torus twice, making the rank-two monodromy visible without extra text.
beats.narration: At the cusp, the paper claim places the monodromy: one point, one twist, one causal change.

beats.causal_move: The twisted torus contracts into the six-sided toric fibre.
beats.frame: The torus remains identity-linked by the cyan seam while its circular cross-section contracts into a glowing hexagon. Six vertices appear as six stable light nodes; the capsule frame fades but the source filament stays continuous.
beats.narration: The proposed degeneration is visible as a single contraction: torus to hexagonal dP6 fibre.

beats.causal_move: The seam closes into a receipt-seal while the source trace remains reachable.
beats.frame: The hexagonal fibre folds into a closed luminous volume on the right. A short world trace loops back to the source slab; the seal shows only RECEIPT and a visible hash-tick pattern. The final caption says CLAIM, not FACT.
beats.narration: Paper claim: the total space is proposed to close as S6; the film closes the scene only with a source pointer and a render receipt.
